description: Cancels one of the user's open or partially filled orders by id, releasing the balance or shares it reserved. Shares that already filled stay filled; only the unfilled remainder is cancelled. Orders that are filled, already cancelled or still processing cannot be cancelled, so check the status with list_orders first.

order_id.description: Id of the order to cancel, from list_orders or place_bet.

name: cancel_order
title: Cancel an order
